_comment: Safe ranges for the average per match, checked by `npm run test:sim` (fixed seeds, normal difficulty, 8 AI-vs-AI matches per ruleset). Widen or move them when you change balance on purpose. Keys are fields of the report printed by scripts/simulate.ts. T19: fouls per match (Arcade = Lenient, target ~2-5; Classic = Strict, with cards); Classic goals widened after Strict fouls brought free kicks (5.2 a match over 40).
